company_events_off_day_check.name: company_events_off_day_check
company_events_off_day_check.value: "calendar"."company_events"."kind" = 'event' or ("calendar"."company_events"."visibility" = 'company' and "calendar"."company_events"."time" is null and "calendar"."company_events"."audience_id" is null)

profiles_leave_check.name: profiles_leave_check
profiles_leave_check.value: ("hr"."profiles"."leave_granted" is null or "hr"."profiles"."leave_granted" >= 0) and ("hr"."profiles"."leave_taken" is null or "hr"."profiles"."leave_taken" >= 0)

app_registry_location_check.name: app_registry_location_check
app_registry_location_check.value: ("core"."app_registry"."kind" = 'external' and "core"."app_registry"."url" ~ '^https?://' and "core"."app_registry"."route" is null) or ("core"."app_registry"."kind" = 'internal' and "core"."app_registry"."route" like '/%' and "core"."app_registry"."url" is null)

generated.as: family_name || case when given_name is null or given_name = '' then '' when (family_name || given_name) ~ '^[ -~]*$' then ' ' || given_name else '　' || given_name end

case when coalesce(family_name_kana, '') = '' and coalesce(given_name_kana, '') = '' then null when coalesce(family_name_kana, '') = '' then given_name_kana when coalesce(given_name_kana, '') = '' then family_name_kana when family_name_kana like '%・%' then family_name_kana || '・' || given_name_kana else family_name_kana || '　' || given_name_kana end
